notes: New 3D toon samurai is now the player (Blender-modeled, real mocap idle/walk/run, jump/fall, hard landings, climbing, rolls, riding pose). His hat is tied on with chin cords, his face stays bright, the clothes have woven patterns and a soft rim light, and the lantern hangs from his hand and swings. New painted sky: big stepped-tone cumulus clouds that change colour through the day, dusk and indigo nights, plus a deeper star field. Journal > Settings lets you switch back to the paper cutout.
